_email_comment: Two addresses on purpose. eventsEmail is for private-event enquiries — the homepage events block and the private events page. `email` is everything else, including the privacy policy and terms, where the contact address has to stay stable.

promo._comment: Dated banners on the home page. Delete an item when it is over, or the whole promo block when none are running — renderPromo emits nothing without it, so no markup has to be touched either way.

popup._comment: Modal on the pages listed below. Delete the whole popup block when the promotion is over: renderPopup emits nothing without it, and the popup script only ships on pages that get one. Change "id" to re-show the popup to people who already dismissed it.
popup.heading: Book your holiday party
popup.body: Nine indoor courts, two bars and a full kitchen under one roof. December dates go fast, so tell us what you have in mind and we'll build the package around it.
